## What this is -- and is not

- Sends a real WhatsApp template message **only when connected to live credentials** and a real, approved WhatsApp phone-number ID. Repository testing uses a local mock server, never the real Meta API.
- The Graph API host is **fixed** (https://graph.facebook.com) -- not configurable via input, to prevent this workflow's outbound request being redirected elsewhere. Only the API version and your phone-number ID are inputs, both strictly validated.
- Requires a WhatsApp Business account, phone-number ID, access token, and an **already-approved** message template -- none of that is provided here.
- **No automatic retries** -- intentional, to avoid sending duplicate WhatsApp messages.
- **No delivery-status tracking.** This only reports whether the send request was accepted.
- Never put a live access token directly in a node parameter -- always use the Header Auth credential, created manually after import.
- Does **not** require any environment variable or instance-level configuration change -- works unmodified on n8n Cloud and default Community Edition installations.
